name: loom
summary: Compile-time dependency injection: one Loom graph wires the configuration, the logger and the installed bindings, and, once http is installed, the HTTP server and the business modules. Every added capability is a Loom project.

changes.summary: make generate builds the Loom generator with the toolchain the project's go.mod selects, so a project whose Go floor is newer than the local go (sqlcx raises it to 1.27) still generates
actions: in the Makefile weld:loom region, change the generate recipe's build line to `cd tools/loom && GOTOOLCHAIN=$$(cd ../.. && go env GOVERSION) go build -o ../../bin/loom-gen github.com/Xwudao/loom/cmd/loom`
